[EN] It appears that many of the spies have disguised themselves as sailors to make it easy to go in and out of the village unnoticed. These suspicious sailors skulk around the pier.

—CatonPut the report away.
[ES] Parece que muchos de los espías se han disfrazado de marineros para entrar y salir del pueblo sin llamar la atención. Estos marineros sospechosos merodean por el muelle.

—CatonPut the report away.
